howto: Press Play. Tap each mole as it pops up.
Do not tap the bunny and chick friends.
Whack enough moles to earn 1, 2 or 3 stars, then go on to the next level.
tips: Gold moles count as three and add two seconds.
Win stars to unlock new hammers and meadow friends.
Win 3 levels a day to fill your daily goal.

controls.keyboard: Number keys 1 to 9 whack the matching hole (number-pad layout, 1 to 4 on small boards); Space starts. P or Esc pauses.

difficulty: 15 levels in three worlds. Holes grow from 4 to 9, moles pop up faster and hide sooner, friends and hard-hat moles join in, and every fifth level has a crowned boss. Star goals are set from a simulated round.

cheats.effect: Big hammer: a whack also hits the moles next door
Extra time: rounds last 15 seconds longer
Slow moles: they stay up much longer

features.one-tap-start: Play starts the next level at once
features.instant-restart: Play again on the results card
features.tutorial-card: Level 1 holds the first mole until you tap it; Help replays
features.results: Stars card with whacks, goal, new prizes and daily goal
